source: .claude/skills/telugu-jyotisha/reference.md: rajju groups §1 (rajju column), Vedha pairs §3 ('standard'), Kuja dosha houses (skill: 'Mars in 2, 4, 7, 8, 12 from lagna, also check from Moon; both partners having it is commonly treated as balanced').
notes: rajju: same rajju group for both partners → flag (serious in many families). vedha: the pair (either order) → flag. kuja: house = ((Mars rasi − reference rasi + 12) mod 12) + 1, counted from the lagna (only when the birth time is known) and from the Moon. onlinejyotish's kuja-dosha-nivarana page also lists house 1 and several cancellations (own/exalted signs, Jupiter's aspect…); they are NOT applied here — pandit review pending. Copy must stay calm: 'worth discussing with an astrologer', never 'do not marry'.
